description: This file provides syntax highlighting functions for JavaScript and JSON code, including escaping HTML special characters, adding span tags with classes for syntax elements, and a public function to select the appropriate highlighter based on language.

methods.name: escapeHtml(s)
methods.description: Escapes HTML special characters (&, <, >) in a string.

methods.name: highlightJavascript(code)
methods.description: Highlights JavaScript code by wrapping keywords, strings, comments, and numbers with HTML span tags.

methods.name: highlightJson(code)
methods.description: Highlights JSON code by wrapping strings, numbers, and boolean/null keywords with HTML span tags.

methods.name: highlightCode(code, language)
methods.description: Public method that highlights code based on the specified language ('javascript', 'js', 'json'). Defaults to escaping for other languages.
